name: Explicit control-phase character-weapon firing at Laser Gate
status: bounded native implementation; official-rule and GEMP source review; no executed GEMP parity

officialSources.finding: Laser Gate can be targeted as a character by a character weapon from either endpoint site, using defense value 3.

Weapons require firing permission and normally target an opponent's cards. A hit outside a battle or attack causes immediate loss. This does not independently establish a firing action during an arbitrary timing window.

Sorry About The Mess and Sniper explicitly permit firing one weapon during the user's control phase, offer their named user's optional per-draw bonus, and immediately lose hit targets. The control-phase permission supplies the timing missing from Laser Gate's target permission.

reference.finding: The Interrupt initially chooses the weapon, responds, then runs FireWeaponEffect; optional named-user modifiers are after-destiny triggers. Native ordering follows this source structure. Laser Gate itself has no implementation in the pinned reference, so this scenario has no independent executed GEMP oracle.

nativeScope: Reachable Light control-phase Sorry About The Mess action chooses a supported character weapon, resolves the Interrupt response, then chooses the opposing Laser Gate from either endpoint.
Pistols, rifles and supported lightsabers use their existing firing-cost and draw-count profiles, intrinsic rifle total modifier, and shared weapon destiny response machinery.
Han's optional per-draw bonus and Bionic Hand's total modifier apply through existing response and total windows.
Weapon cost/use is committed at firing initiation. Original weapon and user references remain latched after initiation; departed/redeployed target instances cannot be hit.
A successful total greater than 3 opens about-to-hit, hit, about-to-lose and card-lost responses. Loss prevention is independently consulted before removal. Failed destiny produces no hit.
Saved continuations bind actor, source, weapon, user, target, action identity, destination and optional bonus to the original shot. Unexpected payment or unrespondable fields are rejected.

verification.scope: Both endpoint sites, hit/miss boundary, pistol/rifle/lightsaber costs and draws, optional Han bonus, Bionic Hand, cancellation at Interrupt/firing/hit, target departure and redeployment, latched weapon departure, loss prevention, serialization and forged continuation rejection.

requiredRemaining: Ordinary battle firing at Laser Gate requires authoritative resolution of participation and timing; no battle action was added.

All other Sorry About The Mess and Sniper targets, seeker targeting, remaining weapon profiles, and all reachable response interactions require implementation and conformance before full card admission.
Sniper shares the bounded handler but a Dark player's own Dark Laser Gate is correctly excluded. No naturally reachable Sniper-against-Gate fixture or URoRRuR'R'R bonus verification is claimed.
The tests exercise native behavior and source-reviewed ordering. They are not independent GEMP parity and do not close starter-deck production admission.
